name: Hatach
overview: Hatach was a trusted chamberlain in the court of King Ahasuerus, serving as a vital messenger between Esther and Mordecai during a critical moment in Israel's history (Esther 4:5-10). His role involved faithfully conveying communications, demonstrating the importance of faithful service and obedience within God's providential plan. Through Hatach's ministry, we see how God can use even those in secular positions to advance His purposes and protect His people.
